label: MBT 10-day daily momentum into RTH (Wednesday shorts)
researchSummary: Daily time-series momentum using a 10-day close-to-close lookback. Filter: short signals on weekday 2.
selectionMethod: Fixed session-edge research grid; pre-2022 training ranked candidates, then post-2022 forward trades had to clear PF/trade-count/split/no-duplicate gates. Management sweep promoted `be_trail_prior_bar_b4` only after strict forward PF improved from 2.36 to 3.07.
verificationSummary: Management sweep `be_trail_prior_bar_b4` strict PF 3.07 over 101 trades, beating baseline PF 2.36; train PF 1.58, bootstrap p05 2.00, block-bootstrap p05 2.01, odd/even min PF 2.40, annual pass rate 100%.
